versions.changelog: Require STEP_AGENT_CMD (no more silent echo default), fix openclaw CLI command refs, add OpenClaw-compliant metadata, capture agent stdout in stepRuns, fix step delay between steps
requiredOutputs: step DONE only when listed paths exist; path escape check; docs and tests
Auto-advance: runner invokes check script after step DONE so next step runs immediately. Tests updated for chained step completion.
Fix python → python3 in all doc examples (SKILL.md, README.md, scripts/README.md). Bare 'python' command does not exist on many systems; now matches the python3 shebangs used by the actual scripts.
Security: reject bash/sh/-c in STEP_AGENT_CMD to prevent command injection. Add validation, explicit shell=False, security docs.
Autonomous recovery; prompt user when step hits snag
Core multi-step scheduler with heartbeat integration
